capabilities.reason: Offline construction only: no model call, tool execution or external service verification.

description: Spawn a subagent to handle a task in the background. Use this for complex or time-consuming tasks that can run independently. Set wait=true for a consultation whose result must inform the current turn. The subagent will complete the task and report back when done. For deliverables or existing projects, inspect the workspace first and use a dedicated subdirectory when helpful.

function.name: spawn

label.description: Optional short label for the task (for display)

task.description: The task for the subagent to complete

temperature.description: Optional sampling temperature for the subagent (0.0 = deterministic, higher = more creative). Defaults to the provider's configured temperature.

wait.description: Wait for the subagent and return its result directly. Use this for a blocking consultation that must inform the current turn. Defaults to false for background execution.

permission_requirements: See implementation-specific guards; not audited here.
preconditions: Registration is limited to the named offline profile.
Execution requires tool-specific services, request context and permissions.

error_categories.observation: prepare_call returns error; tool implementation is not called.
prepare_call coerces/casts and validates parameters; rejected arguments do not call the implementation.
ToolResult.is_error produces an error event in the runner.
Ordinary Exception becomes a registry ToolResult.error or a runner error event; handling differs by entrypoint.
Repeated external lookup/workspace violation guards can reject or escalate; do not infer recoverability from fail_on_tool_error alone.
Cancellation and control-flow BaseException can propagate; hooks may also raise outside the implementation catch.

result_protocols.error_marker: ToolResult.is_error; a plain string beginning with Error: is not by itself a builtin tool failure marker.
result_protocols.event_observation: AgentHookContext.tool_events in runner hooks; not a top-level RunResult field and not emitted as StreamEvent by run().
result_protocols.fail_on_tool_error: False generally returns tool errors to the model for possible recovery; True can terminate with tool_error. Policy guards and continuations also affect the terminal outcome.
result_protocols.registry_return_type: Any; implementation-specific. No universal successful result shape is inferred.

retry.description: The registry does not automatically retry an implementation call. The model may request a new call; provider retries and tool-internal retries are separate.
